segments.he: בְּאֶחָד בְּטֵבֵת לֹא הָיָה בּוֹ מַעֲמָד כּוּ׳. אֲמַר לֵיהּ מָר קַשִּׁישָׁא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב חִסְדָּא לְרַב אָשֵׁי:
segments.en: § The mishna taught that «on the first of Tevet there was no non-priestly watch» at all, as there was an additional offering, hallel, and a wood offering. «Mar Kashisha, son of Rav Ḥisda, said to Rav Ashi:»
